about: A scripted obs-websocket v5 session for the console replay on /websocket/#demo. It was written by hand against protocol.json, not captured from a running release. tools/build.py checks every frame against protocol.json and recomputes the Identify authentication string from the password, salt and challenge below.

frames.note: The server speaks first. authentication is present, so this server needs a password.
authentication = base64(sha256(base64(sha256(password + salt)) + challenge)), here with the password "obs-rust-demo". eventSubscriptions 4 is the Scenes bit.
requestId is the client's own; the response carries it back. This one switches the program output to another scene.
requestStatus code 100 is Success. No responseData: this request only reports its status.
Every client subscribed to Scenes hears the switch.
